claim: Patchline ships a decade impact retrospective tying every major decision to a measured, published outcome. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the decade impact retrospective claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make decade-impact-retrospective-gate`.
